header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في النوم علي طهارة رقم:٥٠٤٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “When a Muslim sleeps at night with Wudu while making Dhikr, and then wakes up in between at some time during the night, whatever he asks of Allah Ta'ala of the good of this world and the Hereafter, Allah Ta'ala will certainly grant it to him,” Rasulullah ﷺ said, narrates Hazrat Mu'adh ibn Jabal (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبَسَةَ ﵁ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ الله ﷺ: إِنَّ أَقْرَبَ مَا يَكُونُ الرَّبُّ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ جَوْفَ اللَّيْلِ اْلآخِرِ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِمَّنْ يَذْكُرُ اللهَ فِي تِلْكَ السَّاعَةِ فَكُنْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقَالَ:هذا حديث صحيح علي شرط مسلم ولم يخرجاه ووافقه الذهبي: ١ /٣٠٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “Indeed, in the last part of the night Allah Ta'ala becomes closest to the servant. If you are able, do the Dhikr of Allah Ta'ala at that time!” Rasulullah ﷺ said to him, narrates Hazrat Amr ibn Abasah (RA).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ﵁ يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ نَامَ عَنْ حِزْبِهِ أَوْ عَنْ شَيْءٍ مِّنْهُ فَقَرَأَهُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ وَصَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ كُتِبَ لَهُ كَأَنَّمَا قَرَأَهُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب جامع صلوة الليل ....رقم:١٧٤٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “If someone falls asleep at night without completing the Awrad he regularly recites, or some part of them, and then completes it (the next day) between the Fajr and Zuhr Salahs, that deed will be written in his record of deeds as a deed done at night,” Rasulullah ﷺ said, Hazrat Umar ibn Khattab (RA)
